meta.title: End to End 1 of 2 - Intake and Routing

views.label: Authenticate and intake
views.note: Runs today: token; tenant + customer from our DB; customerId cross-check; interface, pin, business key; one intake tx.

views.label: Relay and route
views.note: Built with tests, not wired yet: relay, stage consumer, duplicate guard, stage-1 SQL (E11 composition starts them).

views.label: Synchronous variant
views.note: Planned (E11): synchronous inline path - no SYNC code yet.

messages.label: get token (client credentials)
messages.note: Every platform-created client has the default audience scope (ADR-007 D3)

messages.label: POST /api/v1/interfaces/{code}/messages + Bearer + Idempotency-Key
messages.note: Token validated: issuer, JWKS signature, RS256/ES256, aud, exp (ADR-007 D4). Also required: Content-Type application/json and X-Source-Contract-Version. Bulk (:bulk) is planned (E11).

messages.label: ipaas_client_bootstrap(iss, azp): tenant, customer
messages.note: Humans first; then the credential: ACTIVE credentials of ACTIVE tenants only, so a revoke bites at once (ADR-007 D2-D3)

messages.label: 403 body customerId names another customer (recorded)
messages.note: Every customerId / customer_id of the body, per bulk record; none = the credential's customer; nothing stored (ADR-007 D2)

messages.label: bound source: tenant + customer
messages.note: Tenant never from the body or a header: a forged one is ignored and recorded

messages.label: published interface, contract pin, business key
messages.note: IntakeService: unknown or unpublished interface = 404; header version not the published pin, or business key unresolved = 422. Contract JSON Schema + rule validation exists (PayloadValidationService) but intake does not call it yet.

messages.label: one tx: message + payload + outbox
messages.note: One commit (ADR-011 D5). Idempotency-Key is required but not stored or checked yet; the 24 h idempotency store and the per-key sequence are planned (E11).

messages.label: 400, 404, 413 (1 MB), 415, 422, 503 (nothing stored)
messages.note: 400 = missing header or malformed JSON; 415 = missing or wrong Content-Type (IntakeController).

messages.label: relay publishes via the publish port (the Kafka adapter)
messages.note: PostgresOutboxRelay: advisory lock per key bucket (T-179), breaker, acknowledge with timeout. The Kafka publish port is a bean only when IPASS_KAFKA_BOOTSTRAP_SERVERS is set; the relay itself is not started by platform-app yet.

messages.label: record: key = SHA-256(tenant, interface, business key); traceparent header
messages.note: Ids-only value; the row's traceparent is the ONLY header (T-112); the key-bucket advisory lock keeps one publisher per bucket, in order (T-179)

messages.label: stage 1 consumes
messages.note: StageConsumer: tenant from the row via ipaas_work_tenant, never from the record; offset committed only after the work succeeds.

messages.label: claim idempotency_key "outbox:<id>"
messages.note: Consumer-side duplicate guard (T-010): the key is stable per outbox row, so a crash re-publish finds a committed claim - duplicate, acknowledged, no effect (architecture.md section 3, ADR-001)

messages.label: one tx: ACCEPTED to ROUTED + deliveries + outbox
messages.note: SQL built (JdbcStage1Deliveries): key lock; 0 rows = duplicate; insert on conflict (message_id, route_id, created_at) do nothing; one delivery.due outbox row each. The route-condition handler that drives it is planned.

messages.label: DB error: pause partitions, back off
messages.note: A transient database error never poisons a record (ADR-005 D13)

messages.label: inline stage 1, bulkhead permit, claim, one call
messages.note: Planned (E11 A3): message and delivery outbox rows deferred by budget + 5 s (ADR-011 D5).

cards.title: Accepted means stored
items: 202 only after message, payload and outbox commit together
Kafka records carry ids (not wired); the payload stays in PostgreSQL

cards.title: Duplicate-safe (not wired)
items: Same record twice: the duplicate guard's claim detects it
Same key, several relay instances: published in order

cards.title: Status at code main
items: Section 1 runs today; 2 is built, not wired
